<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The plan is clear. I am starting implementation.

Implementation steps are now defined. A new `InMemoryFileService` will live in `src/services/`. Pipeline, analyzer, fixer, and CLI runners will be updated to accept `IFileService`. Unit tests will validate analyze and fix on string sources without temporary directories. Helper utilities may also switch to the in-memory adapter for consistency.

Drafting the `InMemoryFileService` implementation. It stores files in a Map keyed by POSIX paths. The constructor accepts an initial file map and optional ignore patterns. The `resolveFiles` method will match glob patterns against stored keys.

resolveFiles will match exact paths and globs via minimatch, respecting ignore patterns. The constructor seeding and writeFile methods provide sufficient test control without extra helpers. parseContent will remain duplicated rather than extracted into a shared utility.

helpers.ts analyzeCode and fixCode will be wired to InMemoryFileService. This validates the IFileService seam. Disk-based pipeline tests will keep TrackingFileService.

The main acceptance criteria target a dedicated test file for string-source analysis and fixing without temporary directories. cli-handlers will type its resolveFilesOrReport parameter to IFileService for consistency, while cli-agents and cli-runners will keep constructing FileService directly. The implementation sequence is now set: create InMemoryFileService.ts, then update pipeline.ts and analyzer.ts to accept IFileService.

`readFile` and `writeFile` are implemented for the in-memory adapter. Extra getters and setters were considered but omitted to avoid expanding the API beyond what the acceptance criteria require.

A concrete test draft is being written. It seeds a TypeScript source string into an InMemoryFileService instance and runs Pipeline in analyze mode through the registry.

The test draft now includes a fix-mode assertion that the file was modified. Facade functions analyzeFiles and fixFiles will also be typed to accept IFileService. Imports will be split to export the interface alongside the default FileService value.

Pipeline.ts will import IFileService as a type-only reference. cli-agents will keep its existing FileService typing because it lies outside the pipeline entry points. Proceeding to implement.
</details></think>
